title: What if I receive unemployment compensation? | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content What if I receive unemployment compensation? English Español More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Tax articles to share Posters to share Unemployment compensation you received under the unemployment compensation laws of the United States or of a state must be included in your income. It is taxable income. If you received unemployment compensation, you should receive Form 1099-G, Certain Government Payments showing the amount you were paid and any federal income tax you elected to have withheld. Some states do not mail Form 1099-G; recipients need to get the electronic version from their state's website .
